item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Kwon Eunbi and Grammy-winning producer Imanbek released the single “Party Is Not Over” early Friday, according to her agency RBW Entertainment. Kwon's voice is layered over electronic sounds and a deep and addictive baseline, a signature of the Kazakh producer and remixer. item.title: Illit scales back comeback promotions amid members' health concerns
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
K-pop girl group Illit will scale back promotional activities for its fifth EP, "Break Even," as four of its five members face health issues, the group's agency Belift Lab announced Wednesday. In a notice posted on the group's official fan platform, the agency said Yunah, Minju and Wonhee recently visited hospitals after experiencing high fevers and body aches. item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Enhypen will roll out a three-track set, “The Sin: Parallel World,” on Friday, according to Belift Lab on Thursday. item.title: Alpha Drive One to debut in Japan in January
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Alpha Drive One is preparing to enter Japan in full force next year with the release of its single album “青春同盟” (“Youth Alliance”) on Jan. 27, according to agency WakeOne Entertainment on Wednesday. The single album is the group's first release in the country, and will be fronted by “Akatsuki,” the lead single and the group’s first Japanese-language song. item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
SM Entertainment, the K-pop agency behind acts including Exo, Riize and NCT Wish, is preparing to debut a new boy group in January, its first since February 2024.
